proof_review: Four complete approved pages read and visually inspected; their full symbol, residual and signed-component context is distinguished from the present receiving proof.
All seventeen original obligations, fourteen original displays, three full solutions and the exact source-boundary SVG remain.
Full global flow, closed ambient relation, signed maximal times and degree-one normalization use the exact GF providers.
The local variable interval-fiber domain is contracted through its diagonal, positive radius and actual quotient coordinate ball.
Flat path continuation has an explicit compact-square mesh, consistent vertex frames, cancellation of every internal edge and smooth nonzero local coefficient.
The degree-zero dilation identification agrees with flat continuation and commutes with time transport.
The radial half-density power has exact degree n/2 and zero time divergence; the triangular quotient Jacobian and its inverse have all required local bounds.
The scalar equation has the correct factors i and -i, a nonvanishing complex integrating factor and actual zero-diagonal uniqueness.
The moving lower limit includes both the endpoint term and the coefficient input-time derivative.
Fixed-interval interpolation proves all mixed time, quotient and radial derivatives, including the diagonal and backward orientation, with finitely many input seminorms for each output seminorm.
Time-independent overlap factors and uniqueness glue the actual global line-valued section at the exact symbol order.
Microsupport is independent of all frame choices and conic coordinates; its complement is open and conic by the full neighborhood definition.
Forward composition retains zero travel time, includes the source and remains inside the open forward relation.
The hull is closed in the ambient punctured product cotangent space: the closed full relation gives a limit chart, and all witnesses stay in its compact interpolation image.
Radial normalization supplies one uniform compact quotient neighborhood avoiding source witnesses; its finite rapid-decay cover controls every derivative for all large radii.
Reversed time orientation proves the backward closed hull and the corresponding global symbol bound.
Smooth-coefficient times transverse delta has exactly the conormal wavefront over the whole coefficient support, including flat boundaries, by local reciprocal multiplication and closedness.
Explicit flat cutoffs give the example; pseudolocality proves strict-forward exclusion impossible for every correction.
The displayed reflexive correction solves the equation exactly and has the stated minus-one-half conormal order.
Both flat inverse identities, formal adjoints, nonvanishing difference symbol and n=1 smooth exception have the exact signs and dimensions.
Compact time convolution and the complete all-real compact-multiplier estimate act on the actual Sobolev distribution spaces, including negative orders and local support-dependent constants.
The original figure retains exact x=410+160t coordinates, source and correction endpoints, open strict-hull endpoint and accurately specified nonzero transverse covector slice.

Three finite check groups cover complex signs and resonance, moving endpoints, the interpolation identity, density degree and original vector endpoints; the general results follow from the complete text proofs.
